flags.message: Self-declared hold petition: the SG asks the Court to hold this petition for United States v. Jackson, No. 26-304 (CA9), and dispose of it afterwards. The cell's disposition is therefore a function of the lead docket's grant and merits outcome, and the federal-band arrival anchor (~71% pooled reached rate, sal-v4) mixes lead grants with companion GVRs. I forecast well below the anchor on that basis. Expect this event to stay open until after Jackson is resolved (likely mid-2027).
